title: Jensen Huang built the company that powers AI. Now Nvidia must find a way forward without him
description: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has resigned, capping a spectacular downfall for a poster boy of the artificial intelligence boom. His exit on Thursday followed reports of extramarital affairs, and it thrusts the chipmaker into an uncertain future. The resignation came after a dizzying series of headlines about Huang’s infidelity and ties to an alleged Chinese spy. Huang's departure sets off a scramble to find a permanent replacement to lead the multitrillion-dollar colossus that grew from obscurity to a perch between Apple and Microsoft at the top of the S&P index. Shares of Nvidia plummeted 14% at the opening bell, before stabilizing.
